.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/verdi.name: Agent outcome vocabulary checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/verdi.description: Checks that workflow gates use the outcome values declared by the producing agent.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.name: Workflow archive execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.description: Runs the closing step that promotes current work and archives superseded artifacts.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.name: Workflow bookkeeping path checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.description: Checks the paths used by workflow bookkeeping shell commands.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.name: Workflow shell syntax checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.description: Checks that installed workflow shell blocks parse in both Bash and Zsh.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.name: Feature lock execution checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.description: Runs feature resolution and checks that each phase acquires its required lock.

.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.name: Workflow structure checks
.bkit/core/engine/audits/workflows/workf.description: Checks that shipped workflows preserve the structure required by their commands and routing.
